defs: n	A public square, especially in Italian cities.
n	(UK) A roofed gallery or arcade (for example around a public square or in front of a building).
n	(US dialects, especially New England, dated) A veranda; a porch.
n	(uncountable) A baked Italian dish of a thinly rolled bread crust typically topped before baking with tomato sauce, cheese, and other ingredients such as meat or vegetables.
n	(countable) A single instance of this dish.
n	(skiing, skating) snowplow: a maneuver in which the tips of the skis or skates point inwards and the back ends point outwards.
